greet.text: Small folk, smaller voice, eyes that have already priced your boots. "Nob Ashby. I move things from where they're not wanted to where they are. You've got honest hands. Shame, that."

job.text: "The Long Table up on the Feast Steps keeps a horn in its trophy chest. The Hundredth Horn: gold-bound, Hallam drank from it on the hundredth night, so they say, which he didn't. A buyer of mine wants it. The chest's locked and Odo never looks at it. Bring it to me and there's a hundred and fifty in it, and maybe a window without a lantern for you some dark night."

accepted.text: "Quietly. The Long Table never really empties, but nobody up there is looking at the trophies; they're looking at their cups."

again.text: "The horn. Trophy chest. Long Table. I'm not getting younger, and neither's my buyer."

have.text: His eyes go straight to the bag where you put it. "Now there's a sight."

choices.text: Here. A hundred and fifty, you said.

paid_now.text: The horn vanishes so fast you aren't sure you saw it go. "Pleasure. If you ever want more work, look for a window with no lantern in it on the dark of the Wanderer. Knock twice."

paid.text: "Never seen you before in my life, friend. Lovely weather."

returned.text: "You gave it back. To Odo. You had it in your hands and you gave it back." He shakes his head, sincerely sorry for you.
